name: 赤陶·有机
description: 源自 rico-md 的「赤陶·有机」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 18px 50px 18px; font-family: Georgia, Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, Baskerville, serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fdf6ec; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.35; margin: 28px 0 16px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid {{surface}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: {{codeText}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 24px 0 12px; padding: 8px 14px; background-color: rgba(196,120,74,0.08); border-radius: 6px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #3d7a5f; line-height: 1.45; margin: 20px 0 10px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #c4a94a">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{surface}}; color: #fff; padding: 9px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 28px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #c4a94a; max-width: 60px">
